rule: Large feather stores enable safe Sunken-Cove tending
texts: When the feather store at the Watch is large, each Keeper tends the Sunken Cove lanterns safely in winter.

fields.sentence: When the feather store at the Watch is large, each Keeper tends the Sunken Cove lanterns safely in winter.
parse: (: store_large_keeper_tend (Implication (And (Member sk_store_1 large) (Member $x keeper)) (And (Member (sk_tend $x) tend) (Agent (sk_tend $x) $x) (Patient (sk_tend $x) sk_lanterns_1) (Manner (sk_tend $x) safely) (Time (sk_tend $x) winter))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: Bare "when P, Q" where P is a DEFINITE copular STATE ("when the feather store at the Watch is large") and Q is a kind-level universal: the routing rule offers only two arms — generic/indefinite participants in P route to the whenever/occurrence machinery (a reified trigger event plus a During link), and definite/specific participants route to two plain events ordered as stated in a one-off narrative — and neither covers a standing state conditioning a generic universal, so the premise ends up a flat state atom on a top-level witness with no trigger eventuality for During to anchor on.
review.notes: "the Watch" correctly stays a bare capitalized common noun with no Name atom, and "the Sunken Cove lanterns" follows the proper-noun-premodifier pattern (head parsed normally as a definite-plural group witness, linked by opaque Possession, with the name's own kind and Name atoms).
